messages:
Ravi Patel: FYI PortusHealth just escalated — p99 token latency jumped from ~220ms -> ~2.1s across hosted endpoints over the last 45m. CS reports error rate ~5% for longer chat sessions. We need owners and a quick mitigation plan. runtime/routing/infra triage? @Alyssa please coordinate with CS.

Alyssa (oncall): Taking point. @Diego M. (runtime) + @Marie Chen (infra) please ack. I will notify CS and collect customer-facing ETA. Planning a quick mitigation and root cause triage. ETA 10m to initial triage.

Diego M.: Ack. Checking serving runtime now — pool-dedicated-1 shows higher queue depth and more retransmits in the KV cache layer since last kernel push. Suspect batching thresholds or kernel scheduling change. Pulling logs, running perf highlights.

Marie Chen: Ack. On infra side I see elevated packet retransmits on NICs for the PortusHealth AZ (us-west-2b) — ~15% vs normal ~1-2%. Spinning up extra workers in same AZ as short-term scale and checking host-level metrics.

Ella PM: PortusHealth is on a 99.9% SLA; CS says if p99 > 1.5s for >1hr they consider formal breach. They need a mitigation ETA + temporary routing option to avoid degradation.

Diego M.: Quick workaround we can try immediately: reduce batching for their routing tag. Prepared a config diff to set batch_size 8 -> 2 for routing.rule.portushealth. This is targeted per-customer routing, so low blast radius. Command to apply (canary 10%):

```
rcctl routes update --rule portushealth --set batch_size=2 --canary 10 --env prod
```

I can push in ~3m.

Alyssa (oncall): Diego, do the canary for 10% first. Marie, continue with scale-up. I'll keep CS updated: initial mitigation ETA 12m. Owners: runtime=Diego, infra=Marie, oncall=Alyssa.

Diego M.: Canary push done -> canary subset (10%) now using batch_size=2. Early numbers: canary p99 dropped to ~600ms. Monitoring for next 10m. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy request accepted — routing.rule.portushealth.batch_size changed to 2 for canary subset (10%). CI checks passed; rollout started.

Marie Chen: Extra workers are up (2x). Observed egress retransmit improve to ~4% after kernel NIC offload toggles. Still watching host queues.

Ravi Patel: Great progress — thanks. CS: please send the customer a short note about the temporary routing change + request to avoid heavy backfills for the next hour. Follow-ups: Diego to open PR for an adaptive per-customer batching flag (ENG-8943 created), Marie to file infra postmortem if NIC root cause confirmed.

Alyssa (oncall): Looping: if p99 remains >1s for PortusHealth after 30m we'll escalate to oncall-sre and consider rollback of the kernel push. I will ping again at +30m with status.
